2: (() => {

6:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;

10:   let asteroids = [];
11:   let powerUps = [];
12:   let fuel = 100; // percent

14:   let gameOver = false;

18:   const stars = [];

21:       x: Math.random() * WIDTH,
22:       y: Math.random() * HEIGHT,
23:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
24:       alpha: Math.random(),
25:       delta: Math.random() * 0.02 + 0.01,
26:     });
27:   }
28: 
29: // ----- Audio -----
30:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
31:   const playTone = (freq, duration, type = 'sine') => {
32:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
33:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
34:     osc.type = type;
35:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
36:     osc.connect(gain);
37:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
38:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
39:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
40:     osc.start();
41:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
42:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
43:   };
44:   const playThrust = () => playTone(400, 80);
45:   const playExplosion = () => playTone(100, 300, 'sawtooth');
46:   const playPowerUp = () => playTone(800, 120, 'triangle');
47: 
48:   // ----- Helpers -----
49:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
50:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
51:     const size = rand(15, 40);
52:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(size, WIDTH - size), y: -size, r: size, speed: rand(1, 3) });
53:   };
54:   const spawnPowerUp = () => {
55:     const size = 15;
56:     powerUps.push({ x: rand(size, WIDTH - size), y: -size, size, speed: 1.5 });
57:   };
58: 
59:   // ----- Drawing -----
60:   const drawShip = () => {
61:     ctx.save();
62:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
63:     // gradient ship body
64:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.size, 0, ship.size);
65:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
66:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
67:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
68:     ctx.beginPath();
69:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.size);
70:     ctx.lineTo(ship.size / 2, ship.size);
71:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size / 2, ship.size);
72:     ctx.closePath();
73:     ctx.fill();
74:     // outline
75:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
76:     ctx.lineWidth = 2;
77:     ctx.stroke();
78:     ctx.restore();
79:   };
80:

82:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
83:       const radGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
84:       radGrad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
85:       radGrad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
86:       ctx.fillStyle = radGrad;
87:       ctx.beginPath();
88:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);

91:   };

95:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.size);

102:     });
103:   };

179:     drawAsteroids();
180:     drawPowerUps();
181:     drawHUD();
182:   };
183: 
184:   const loop = () => {
185:     update();
186:     render();
187:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:   };
189: 
190:   // ----- Input -----
191:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
192:     if (gameOver && e.key === 'Enter') {
193:       asteroids = [];
